item.title: A message from: Mr. Warner.
item.description: The junior girls basketball team were in Brockville this past weekend for the Maja Spence Memorial tournament. The girls beat St. Mary from Brockville, lost a tight one to Syndenham and finished with a tremendous team defensive effort while beating their arch nemesis Arnprior! That last convincing win earned them the bronze medal. They could not have represented STA any better as the played with grit, heart and sportsmanship under some difficult circumstances. Fantastic job ladies, we are super proud of you!
